name: Maiden's Folly Charts
summary: Maiden's Folly Charts are navigational records recovered from a wreck in the Arathi Highlands. First Mate Nilzlix wants them secured before the ships leave the cove.

sections.title: Charts from the Wreck
sections.body: In the Arathi Highlands, the Maiden's Folly lies wrecked beside the Spirit of Silverpine. Their charts and logs record information the crew fears could reach enemy hands. First Mate Nilzlix asks you to recover the charts, including those from the Maiden's Folly, and bring them back to him before the ships leave the cove.

faq.q: What are the Maiden's Folly Charts?
faq.answer: They are navigational charts that belonged to the Maiden's Folly, now wrecked in the Arathi Highlands.

faq.q: Where can I find the charts?
faq.answer: The Maiden's Folly lies wrecked in a cove in the Arathi Highlands.
First Mate Nilzlix asks you to recover the Maiden's Folly Charts and the ships' other records.

faq.q: Why must the charts be secured?
faq.answer: The crew fears the charts and logs could fall into enemy hands, and Fleet Master Seahorn would hold them responsible.
The recovered charts go back to First Mate Nilzlix in the cove; knowing they are secure eases the command in Booty Bay.
